allowed_use: Evidence that paged block-table indirection does not explain the difference between the paged and contiguous production prefill variants on either target.
finding: Block-table indirection does not change realised K/V reuse. Holding the geometry, the footprint and the reference order fixed and moving only the addressing, A800 reads exactly the 64 MiB unique footprint in all four configurations (64.0-64.1 MiB, paged against contiguous indistinguishable), and C500 reads 182.7 against 177.5 MiB at Q tile 128 and 240.9 against 227.4 at Q tile 64, against a 2.5 percent repeatability measured by repeating the tile-128 pair. The production variants differ by 1.78x on C500 and 1.21x on A800 at this exact geometry, so paging is falsified as the mechanism. The Q tile axis here also runs opposite to production: this probe reads 1.30x more at tile 64 than at tile 128, while production reads 0.56x as much.
forbidden_use: Any duration. Also not an L2 capacity, a DRAM bandwidth, a replacement policy, or a per-shape traffic correction.

geometry.block_table: (i*2654435761)%blocks, a permutation so the footprint is unchanged and only addresses move

why_independent_axes: Two production prefill variants of one identical shape differ only in kv_layout and measure 1.78x apart on C500. The Q tile and the CTA concurrency were already falsified by attention_q_tile_kv_residency. This probe moves only the block-table indirection, crossed with the two production Q tiles, and repeats one pair to bound repeatability.
